description: One product by SKU or URL slug: the search summary plus tags and attributes such as warranty, core charge and whether dealer service is required. Unknown identifiers return found:false. Never determines fitment: do not assert that a product fits a specific vehicle; send the customer to the product URL. UCP form: pass catalog.id. Example: {"identifier":"GMED-REPLACEMENTHMI"}

id.description: Product ID, SKU or URL slug.

identifier.description: Simple form, required. SKU or URL slug.

meta.description: UCP form, optional. Any call with "catalog" or "meta" is UCP and returns structuredContent (prices in minor units).

profile.description: Your platform profile URL (https). Recorded, never fetched.

name: get_product
title: Get product
